v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

content-calibrator v1.0.0

- Initial release with a closed-loop content quality calibration and prediction system.
- Supports 7-dimension rating (ER, HP, SR, QL, NA, AB, PV), blind prediction, T+3d review, and rubric evolution, each platform iterated independently.
- Batch processing runs weekly (Monday 09:00) to minimize token consumption, using sensenova-6.7-flash-lite for scoring and deepseek-v4-flash for review.
- Includes CLI scripts and JSON input/output for modular integration.
- Exception handling and platform-specific rubric management introduced.
